target.title: feat(ios): implement branded design system in SwiftUI
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The iOS app had no centralized design system aligned with the branded styling guide: inconsistent colors (system blue/orange/green), inline system fonts, duplicated toggle UI, and ad-hoc spacing/radius values across onboarding, settings, chat, talk, and gateway screens.

## Why This Change Was Made

This implements the design guide directly in SwiftUI as shared tokens and components, without changing navigation or product behavior. It adds Claw Red/Teal brand colors, bundled Plus Jakarta Sans / DM Sans / JetBrains Mono fonts with Dynamic Type, spacing/radius/motion tokens, shared toggle/badge/banner/button components, and migrates ~30 views to the new system.

## User Impact

- Onboarding, settings, chat, talk, and gateway screens use consistent branded typography, colors, and button hierarchy
- Chat user bubbles use Claw Red instead of system blue in light mode
- Status indicators (privacy permissions, gateway pill) use semantic brand badges
- No workflow or feature behavior changes

## Evidence

### Screenshot methodology (v3 — verified clean)

Both builds used the full clean pipeline: `git checkout <ref>` → `pnpm ios:gen` (regenerate Xcode project from that ref's `project.yml`) → delete DerivedData → `xcodebuild build` → install on simulator → launch with `--openclaw-screenshot-mode --openclaw-appearance dark --openclaw-initial-tab <tab>`.

**Before:** `upstream/main` @ `c032f9809d`. Verified: `Sources/Fonts/` directory does not exist; 0 `PlusJakartaSans*.ttf` / `DMSans*.ttf` / `JetBrainsMono*.ttf` in app bundle; `Info.plist` has no `UIAppFonts` entries.

**After:** `feat/ios-design-system` @ `b0eb41da67`. Verified: 6 Plus Jakarta Sans + 5 DM Sans + 3 JetBrains Mono fonts in app bundle; `UIAppFonts` lists 14 entries.

**Visible delta example (Chat header):** main shows a green checkmark icon; this PR shows the `OpenClawStatusBadge` "Connected" pill.

### Chat

**What changed:** Gateway status indicator switches from a small green checkmark icon to an `OpenClawStatusBadge` "Connected" pill with green dot. Typography moves from SF Pro (system) to Plus Jakarta Sans. "Molty" header uses `OpenClawType.headline` weight.

| Before (`main` @ c032f9809d) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|
| ![chat before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before/02-chat-connected.png?v=3) | ![chat after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after/02-chat-connected.png?v=3) |

### Settings

**What changed:** All row labels, section headers ("Device"), and subtitles switch from SF Pro to Plus Jakarta Sans via `OpenClawType` tokens. Gateway card and row layout unchanged, but font metrics shift slightly due to different typeface character widths.

| Before (`main` @ c032f9809d) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|
| ![settings before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before/05-settings-connected.png?v=3) | ![settings after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after/05-settings-connected.png?v=3) |

### Talk

**What changed:** Typography moves from SF Pro to Plus Jakarta Sans ("Talk is off", "Gateway relay ready", "Start Talk" label). Accent red on the "Start Talk" button shifts from muted red (183,56,51) to brighter Claw Red (232,48,42). Subtitle text uses `OpenClawType.caption` token.

| Before (`main` @ c032f9809d) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|
| ![talk before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before/03-talk-connected.png?v=3) | ![talk after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after/03-talk-connected.png?v=3) |

### Control

**What changed:** "Control" heading and all row labels (Overview, Activity, Workboard, etc.) switch from SF Pro to Plus Jakarta Sans. Gateway card subtitle "Molty (main)" and "Online" status text use branded typography tokens. Layout and icon set unchanged.

| Before (`main` @ c032f9809d) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|
| ![control before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before/01-control-connected.png?v=3) | ![control after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after/01-control-connected.png?v=3) |

### Agent

**What changed:** "Agents" heading, search bar placeholder, agent names ("Molty", "Automation", "Research"), and model labels ("gpt-5.5") switch from SF Pro to Plus Jakarta Sans. Agent list card styling and avatar circles unchanged.

| Before (`main` @ c032f9809d) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|
| ![agent before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before/04-agent-connected.png?v=3) | ![agent after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after/04-agent-connected.png?v=3) |

### Validation commands

```bash
# Verify main has no bundled fonts, branch does:
git checkout upstream/main && pnpm ios:gen
cd apps/ios && xcodebuild -project OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw \
  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro" build
ls Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/OpenClaw.app/PlusJakartaSans*.ttf  # expect: none

git checkout feat/ios-design-system && rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/OpenClaw-*
pnpm ios:gen && cd apps/ios && xcodebuild ... build
ls Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/OpenClaw.app/PlusJakartaSans*.ttf  # expect: 6 files

# Typography tests
xcodebuild test -scheme OpenClaw -only-testing:OpenClawTests/OpenClawTypographyTests
```

- iOS simulator build: **BUILD SUCCEEDED**
- `OpenClawTypographyTests`: **2/2 passed**

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

- Behavior or issue addressed: Branded iOS design system (colors, typography, spacing, shared components) applied across primary tabs
- Real environment tested: macOS, Xcode iOS Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro), Debug build; before from `upstream/main` @ `c032f9809d`, after from this branch @ `b0eb41da67`
- Exact steps or command run after this patch: for each ref: `git checkout <ref>`, `pnpm ios:gen`, `rm -rf DerivedData`, `xcodebuild build`, `simctl install`, launch with `--openclaw-screenshot-mode --openclaw-appearance dark --openclaw-initial-tab <tab>`, `simctl io screenshot`; plus `OpenClawTypographyTests`
- Evidence after fix: before/after PNGs linked above (assets branch `pr-assets/ios-design-system`, commit `7cd910e`)
- Observed result after fix: custom fonts in after build only; chat header changes from checkmark to Connected badge; branded typography on all tabs
- What was not tested: physical device walkthrough, light mode matrix, iPad layouts
- Proof limitations: screenshot fixture mode, not live gateway pairing

— [Joel Nishanth](https://offlyn.ai) · [offlyn.AI](https://offlyn.ai)
